description: Authored synthetic posts and predefined outcomes for a repeatable interview walkthrough. No real alerts, people, model predictions, or measured accuracy.

posts.text: Found a new coffee shop in Austin. Excellent breakfast tacos, questionable parking.
Flash flood warning for Austin, Texas. Heavy rain has flooded low-water crossings across the city.
Our offense is on fire tonight. Absolutely flooding the scoreboard!
The streets in Houston are underwater and people are trapped in their homes.
posts.context: Parent post: Checking in from Houston, Texas after the storm.

posts.text: Flooding in Portland. The road outside is completely underwater.
The Willamette has overflowed into streets in Portland, Oregon. Crews are closing the riverside road.
Extreme heat warning for Phoenix, Arizona. Dangerous heat is expected through the evening.
Another road closed by floodwater in Austin, Texas. Cars are turning around at the barricades.
My cat has stolen my chair again. Negotiations are not going well.
Coastal flooding along the waterfront in Portland, Maine, by Casco Bay. Water is covering the street.
Planning a hiking trip next month. That canyon is prone to flooding, so I'm checking the forecast before booking.
Power is out across our neighborhood in Mora, New Mexico. The whole street has been dark for an hour.
Emergency crews in Solon, Iowa are responding to a drowning at a nearby lake.
Floodwater has closed roads in Brisbane, Australia after heavy overnight rain.
Wildfire evacuation warning near Redding, California. A fast-moving vegetation fire is threatening nearby homes.
Reading a book about the 1906 San Francisco earthquake. The old photographs are incredible.
Rescue boats are helping people out of flooded homes in Houston, Texas this afternoon.
No flooding on our street in Austin, Texas. The drains handled the rain and the road is clear.
Tornado warning for Wichita, Kansas. A tornado has been reported near the city.
There is a pandemic of terrible movie sequels this year. Please let the originals rest.
A transformer failed in Santa Fe, New Mexico and several blocks have lost electricity. Traffic signals are out too.
Hurricane warning for Tampa, Florida. Hurricane-force winds are expected as the storm approaches.
Strong earthquake shaking in Los Angeles, California just now. Items fell off shelves in our apartment.
A little drizzle in Seattle today. Perfect excuse to stay in and finish my book.
